narrative.details:
A small placard on one of the ends of the keg says,

"Chen Stormstout-

May your spirit be raised and always raise your spirits."
narrative.objectives: Find someone who knows about Chen's Empty Keg.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well, I'll be...

This was one of Chen Stormstout's kegs. He traveled with Rexxar a long time ago. I haven't seen or heard about him in a kodo's age. I appreciate you bringing this to me, adventurer.
